title: a JITSO handler inside a user's group is taken out of it, the user's other handlers stay, and duplicate JITSO groups collapse to one
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). jitso never edits a user's group beyond removing its own handler: a group that held `./a.sh` and a JITSO handler keeps `./a.sh`; two duplicate JITSO `Bash` groups disappear; the three desired groups are appended after the user's. Since N-25 the guard also has a third PreToolUse group, `Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit`. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.
